allowed_native_controller_calls_per_case.interrupt_agent: 0 unless bounded terminal cleanup after a consumed failure

controller_contract.task_name: r9_goal_case_ followed by case_id without punctuation

pre_goal_visibility.opaque_path_rule: The basename is exactly {case_id}.json under the fixed directory cases/. No semantic word may occur in matrix_id, case_id, task_name, or any path component.
pre_goal_visibility.subject_first_visibility: The first subject byte may enter model context only as output of the exact file-read tool call after create_goal returned ACTIVE and the raw ACTIVE receipt was sent to /root.

question: Does this closed gate keep every subject byte out until native Goal ACTIVE, then finish in one same-Goal turn with trace-verifiable order and no parent follow-up?

spawn_message.framing: Exact UTF-8 bytes with no implicit prefix, suffix, markdown fence, or terminal LF.
spawn_message.goal_objective_literal: R9 {case_id}; run {matrix_id}; one case; no retry.
spawn_message.literal: Create Goal "{goal_objective}". If not ACTIVE, stop unread. Send /root ACTIVE receipt. Then open only {subject_path}; require {subject_bytes} bytes and SHA256 {subject_sha256}; answer its one case; send result; complete Goal; send receipt; return. No follow-up/retry/delegation.

trace_attestation.fail_closed: Missing rollout, ambiguous path, malformed event, unpaired tool call/result, extra model turn, ordering mismatch, or subject evidence before ACTIVE fails the case and matrix.
trace_attestation.pre_goal_absence: Before the ACTIVE create_goal result, the rollout must contain zero subject-file substrings of length at least 16, zero question bytes, zero source excerpt bytes, zero answer-choice bytes, zero output-contract bytes, and zero subject-path read calls.
required_order: first subject file read tool call
trace_attestation.source: Exact fresh child Codex rollout JSONL located by the ACTIVE Goal threadId after task terminal.
trace_attestation.subject_read_definition: The first tool event whose arguments name the exact opaque subject_path or whose output contains any exact subject-file byte substring of length at least 32.
